notes.title: VRMS is live!
notes.content:
VRMakingSense is live :-)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30810522/cd788a95a1c531a7253591e3f3a0d1bed087d9bd.jpg[/img]

Some ideas for how the tool can be used:
[list]
    [*] Prioritising tasks
    [*] Making sense of a complex codebase/domain  
    [*] Planning who is sitting where during wedding 
    [*] Learning capitals of the world  
    [*] Learning new vocabulary
[/list]

Please provide your feedback in comments:
[list]
    [*] What are you using it for?
    [*] What features would you like to see added/improved?
    [*] Any bugs?
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30810522/952f503bbe0c99a2ed86bc88088b440e46d2bec8.png[/img]
